title: Concept: mix.lock entry without a checksum
description: mix.lock declares a locked package that records no hash, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Mix cannot verify the fetched package against the lockfile, so a mirror can serve different code for the same version.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through mix.lock (hex).
risk: Mix cannot verify the fetched package against the lockfile, so a mirror can serve different code for the same version.
